How it works

Three taps from a quieter mind.

No onboarding maze. No forms. Open it, and start talking.

Tap the orb

Start a conversation in your language.

Talk like you would to a friend

Interrupt, switch languages mid-sentence, just vent.

We remember what matters

Your reflections build over time. Private, never read by humans.

Voice-first

Say it out loud.

Tap the orb and just talk, the way you would to a friend on the phone. Luma listens, takes a breath, and answers in a calm, real voice. Interrupt it, ramble, go quiet. There is no script to follow.

  • Natural back-and-forth, not commands
  • Switch languages mid-sentence
  • Works hands-free, eyes closed
Text, too

Not in the mood to speak?

Some nights you just want to type. Luma is the same companion in text, gentle, curious, never in a hurry. Switch between voice and text whenever it feels right, mid-conversation.

  • Type when the room is quiet
  • One thread, voice or text
  • Always remembers where you left off
Twelve voices

Pick who feels like home.

A quiet listener who asks one good question. A grounded, steady presence. Warm older-sister energy. Choose the voice that fits how you want to be met, and change your mind any time.

  • Distinct personalities, not settings
  • Native voices in every language
  • Preview before you commit
It remembers

A thread that builds over time.

Luma gently keeps track of what matters to you, opens with a thought worth sitting with, and brings you a quiet recap each week. Your reflections, building, private, and never read by a human.

  • A daily prompt made for you
  • Weekly reflections & recaps
  • Yours alone, encrypted
Calm tab

Small practices for heavy moments.

When talking is too much, Calm is there. Guided breathing, box breathing, the 4-7-8 rhythm, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding. Quick, quiet things you can do in under a minute, right where you are.

  • Guided breathing for any mood
  • Grounding when anxiety spikes
  • No setup, just tap and breathe

Meet the voices

Four in each language. One is free in your language, unlock all twelve with premium, and switch any time.

Private & safe

What you say here, stays here.

Never read by humans

Your conversations are yours. No human reviews them, ever. They power your experience and nothing else.

Built with care

Luma is designed to support, not diagnose. It is not therapy or a medical service, and it never pretends to be.

It knows its limits

In a hard moment, Luma gently points you toward real human help and local crisis lines. You are never alone with it.
